metadata.title: Iris
metadata.description: A multi-platform short video monitoring console

marketing.metaTitle: Iris · Short-form intelligence and operations workspace
marketing.metaDescription: Monitor competitors, manage accounts and proxies, schedule content, and publish across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube in one team workspace.
marketing.heroTitle: Spot the opportunity, then ship the content at scale
marketing.heroDescription: Iris brings Monitor and Ops into one team workspace: track competitor performance, manage accounts, proxies, and cloud phones, schedule content, and run cross-platform publishing workflows.
marketing.inviteOnly: Invite-only preview for cross-border brands and marketing teams
marketing.monitorDashboardAlt: Sanitized demonstration of the Iris Monitor competitor intelligence dashboard
marketing.opsDashboardAlt: Sanitized demonstration of the Iris Ops cross-platform operations dashboard
marketing.featuresTitle: One Iris workspace, from insight to execution
marketing.feature1Description: Track accounts, content, views, and publishing trends by platform and date range.
marketing.feature2Title: Accounts and runtime in one place
marketing.feature2Description: Give the team one view of operating accounts, proxy status, and cloud-phone readiness.
marketing.feature3Description: Import videos, plan the publishing cadence, and ship to TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube.
marketing.feature4Description: See publishing status, retries, TikTok and Facebook comment tasks, and system health together.
marketing.workflowTitle: Move from opportunity to repeatable execution without switching tools
marketing.workflow1Description: Bulk import competitor profiles, then compare account and content performance by group, platform, and time range.
marketing.workflow2Description: Manage accounts, proxies, cloud phones, and the video queue so the team always knows what comes next.
marketing.workflow3Description: Run scheduled publishing and comment tasks, track exceptions, then return to Monitor to review performance.
marketing.pricingTitle: Pricing for the complete growth loop
marketing.pricingDescription: Every plan includes the complete Monitor + Ops product; only shared monitored-account capacity changes.
marketing.planIncludes: Complete Monitor + Ops: competitor intelligence, account and proxy management, scheduling, four-platform publishing, comment tasks, and operational tracking.
marketing.pricingFootnote: Priced per team workspace. Members share capacity; tiers currently vary only by monitored accounts, with no separate per-seat Ops fee.
marketing.ctaTitle: Bring insight and execution into one Iris workspace
marketing.footerDescription: From competitor intelligence to account operations and cross-platform publishing, Iris helps global teams turn opportunities into repeatable action.
